Expenditure on

Cards to Voters
(Establishment and

Expenditure)
column7:
Final excess of ₹2.42
lakh is overstated due
to clearance of OB
suspense related to
previous years.
Reduction in provision
of ₹213.62 lakh was
the net effect of
increase of ₹100.00
lakh and surrender of
₹313.62 lakh. Increase
was attributed to need
of additional amounts
for issuance of voter id
card. Reasons for
surrender have not been
intimated (July 2025).
